note: Reads the 4-byte PMX magic header 'PMX ' from attacker-controlled input; must match to enter the parser.
Reads the PMX version float; must be 2.0f or 2.1f to continue parsing.
Reads the settings byte count; must be >= 8 to pass the size check.
Reads the text encoding flag; value 0 selects the UTF16-to-UTF8 conversion path in ReadString.
Calls ReadString with attacker-controlled size and encoding=0, entering the vulnerable UTF16 conversion path.
Reads the string byte length from input; attacker sets size to a small even value (e.g. 2).
Reserves capacity for size bytes but leaves the vector's logical size at 0; ASAN container annotations mark the region [begin, begin+0) as poisoned.
Writes size bytes into buffer.data() beyond the logical end (size 0) but within capacity; with _GLIBCXX_SANITIZE_VECTOR this triggers an AddressSanitizer container-overflow WRITE.
Reinterprets the buffer as UTF16 code units; the poisoned container region is then read by utf16to8, producing the container-overflow READ at the memory-safety sink.
